description: The scattered characters pursue new kingdoms, alliances and romances as Galavant’s quest expands into a much stranger contest over who should rule and what any of them actually want.

s02e01.description: Shipwrecked Galavant and Richard try to return to Valencia, while Gareth pushes to be crowned king, Isabella plans escape from Hortensia and Sid accidentally reveals too much about what lies ahead.

s02e02.description: A fortune teller connects Galavant with Isabella but mangles their messages badly enough to convince her he no longer loves her, while Gareth and Madalena feud over palace decoration.

s02e03.description: Richard finds his castle dismantled into a community center, Galavant tries to recruit villagers for Isabella’s rescue, and Wormwood begins controlling Isabella through an enchanted tiara.

s02e04.description: Galavant tries to separate from Richard after another dangerous encounter and nudges him toward Roberta, while Chef notices Isabella’s unnatural attachment to Wormwood’s magical tiara.

s02e05.description: After arguing over Richard’s supposed dragon, Galavant and Richard land on opposite sides of a giant-dwarf conflict while Isabella breaks free of Wormwood’s control.

s02e06.description: Isabella banishes Wormwood as Galavant returns home and discovers his father now runs a sword-fighting school for troubled boys, complicating his assumptions about the man he left behind.

s02e07.description: Sid, Richard and Roberta race a dying Galavant to healer Neo of Sporin while Wormwood engineers war between Hortensia and Valencia and Gareth and Madalena confront their feelings.

s02e08.description: Galavant tries to inspire his newly raised zombie army, Richard and Roberta embrace their romance, and Madalena secretly asks Wormwood to teach her the Dark Dark Evil Way.

s02e09.description: Galavant’s zombies initially shift the battle between Hortensia and Valencia until Wormwood and Madalena seize control of them, forcing Gareth to recognize Madalena’s betrayal.

s02e10.description: Gareth joins Galavant’s side against Madalena, Richard finally rises as the one true king when Wormwood kills Tad, and Isabella confronts Madalena in the final battle.
